conversion_funnel.portability: Signed HMAC-SHA256 workspace portability bundle (/api/open-core/portability, src/tree/open-core/workspace-portability-store.ts). Allows self-hosted community users to export their channel configurations, script templates, and SOP workflows (excluding raw BYOK keys) and import them into Sophia Managed Cloud in under 60 seconds.
conversion_funnel.telemetry_beacon: Optional, privacy-preserving version beacon (/api/version) checking for security advisories and upgrade paths (opt-out available via SOPHIA_DISABLE_VERSION_BEACON=true).

active_bet.name: Partner-Resell Kit (customer-side affiliate program)
active_bet.status: GO (conditional) — design complete, implementation not started
active_bet.hypothesis: Re-point the existing attribution + dual-rail payout engine so every paid Cloud customer can recruit and pay their own partners from inside their own workspace. Converts the repo's largest subsystem from an operator tool into a reason to pay $399/mo, and makes the customer's own acquisition channel also Sophia's.

edition_placement.community: tenant_id-scoped schema and attribution primitives only (click recording, code generation, consent-gated capture, attribution resolver) — no payout capability
edition_placement.cloud: multi-partner workspace program, dual-rail payout orchestration (VietQR/NAPAS + USDT), anti-fraud risk scoring, payout batching
edition_placement.enterprise: white-label partner portal per subaccount, custom domain on the partner portal

active_bet.plg_upgrade_trigger: A self-hoster can generate partner links and record clicks. Paying out many partners — batching, VietQR/NAPAS CSV export, risk scoring, refund clawback, Net-30 scheduling — stops working on the free core. That boundary is the CommercialUpgradeModal + /api/open-core/portability catch point.
verified_evidence: src/land/affiliates holds 187 files; 12 of the last 19 commits touch affiliate/payout/commission files and 7 touch none, and payout logic lives in src/tree/affiliates/ledger/ rather than src/land/payouts

affiliate_links, click_events and conversion_events carry tenant_id from migration 0035; migration 0079 extends tenant_id to discovered_affiliates — so customer separation is a parameter rather than a rewrite
src/forest/actions/affiliate-self-signup.ts is a real server action returning /ref/<code>, and src/app/ref/[code]/page.tsx sets a consent-gated 30-day cookie and records clicks

blockers.detail: src/tree/affiliates/ledger/payout-disbursement.ts deliberately stopped blocking payouts on partner.status = 'under_review' (only 'suspended' blocks now), because the nightly risk scorer has no automatic recovery path and one false positive froze a partner's payouts permanently. Partner-Resell Kit hands unknown partners to non-technical customers, where false positives are likelier. Founder must decide whether the risk scorer stays advisory (a notification) or becomes a hard block, which would require building a recovery path first.

evaluateFeatureGate is called only by /api/open-core/status and the 25-step catalog auditor, so the manifest minimum tiers are documentation rather than enforcement. A free-core instance could otherwise reach real payouts.

payouts/resolve-payout-method.ts prefers Stripe Connect for affiliate payouts. The Stripe ban covers customer billing, not partner payouts, but a Vietnamese operator paying partners in VND cannot use it. Founder must choose between PayOS/VietQR and Stripe for the payout rail.
